title: Munichi language - Wikipedia
text: Munichi is an extinct language which was spoken in the village of Munichis, about 10 miles west of Yurimaguas, Loreto Region, Peru. The last known fluent speaker, Victoria Huancho Icahuate, died in the late 1990s, but the language was already moribund by the 1930s.
